name: ewma-constant-rate-due-soon
description: Four readings 10 days apart at exactly 30 km/day. With 2+ readings the 700 km/week baseline is ignored. Confidence = (1 - 0.5^3) x 1 (no variance) x 0.5^(10/30) = 0.69449. 600 km left from the last reading = 20 days, due 2026-11-24, 10 days out, so due_soon. ±ceil(10 x 0.30551) = ±4 days.
